intro: Brutal Helm marks the culmination of an arduous warrior trial overseen by Orm Stonehoof atop Thunder Bluff. Having collected rare beast trophies across Kalimdor, an aspiring warrior is recognized with a formidable horned helm as a testament to their strength.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I give this helm to you.
Great deeds brought you to me, friend, and Earthmother willing... Even greater deeds lie before you.
